45: Who retracted his warning - at this point we are working under the assumption that this dilemma is being raised whether he retracted [his warning] before or after the seclusion. If you say that one who desires to remain married to one who violates the precepts may remain married to her -- that [surely] applies if there was no warning delivered. But where there was a warning delivered, and there was seclusion, and he wishes to retract, what [is the halakha]? Can he abrogate his warning, and [have] her be permitted to him, or not?
